context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the create-prd instructions from the published agnostic-planning-skills tile.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Goal:** Draft a clear, actionable PRD from a feature request.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Constraints:** Focus on what/why. No code. Save to `/tasks/prd-<slug>.md`.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Flow:** Clarify if ambiguous → Draft using template → Get explicit approval.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Draft** — fill **[PRD_TEMPLATE.md](./PRD_TEMPLATE.md)** section by section. Do not invent a parallel outline.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Save to** `/tasks/prd-<feature-slug>.md` (kebab-case). State the path.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Write requirements in natural language** — not code. "The system must send a confirmation email when…"

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Close with next steps** — typically: "Run `generate-tasks` once this PRD is approved."
